market_outlook.short_term: Cautious. Oil-driven inflation pressure and valuation vulnerability cap upside. EM rotation and Polish outperformance provide pockets of strength. Rate uncertainty keeps bonds and crypto in wait-and-see mode. Expect 2-4% volatility in US equities over next 30 days.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but uneven. AI capex cycle ($1.3T in 2027) drives structural growth but FCF concerns limit multiples. EM capital formation (Dangote, Jio) and tokenisation create new alpha. Climate and tariff risks create commodity tailwinds. 6-12 month: moderate equity gains (5-8%) with sector rotation favoring energy, EM, and cybersecurity over consumer discretionary.
